title: Fix join-time write race: retry register_agent on Conflict (review finding F1)
desc: register_agent (bin/chatcode:754-761) does a single unprotected sha+write; any concurrent branch write makes GitHub answer 409 and chatcode init dies with a traceback (real crash at my own join). Fix: wrap in the same read-sha/write/retry-on-Conflict loop update_task uses; rebuild content each attempt. Verify: Conflict-injecting stub test + --local end-to-end init + real re-init against live repo. Evidence and context: my review in #dev, message #ff420b86.
